thread:
alice: Heads-up: eval-runner nondet on quantized vm for new-model A. Repro locally with same seed gives different outputs across worker restarts :confused:
sasha: Can you paste the minimal command / config?
alice: here's how I run it:
```bash
EVAL_SEED=12345 RUNNER_MODE=resume ./tools/eval_runner --model redwood-qa-q4f
``` I see sample drift when a worker crashes and restarts.
michael: What sampling params? temp/top_k/top_p?
alice: temp=0.7 top_k=50 top_p=0.95. But the mismatch is in top-k selection for token 27 onwards, looks like RNG stream jumped.
kai: Do you have sampler_debug logs? We added stream_id tags last week.
alice: Attached snippet:
```log
[worker-2] stream_id=7 seed=12345 idx=26 pick=token_142
[worker-3] stream_id=8 seed=12345 idx=27 pick=token_99
```
Why did stream_id change?
sasha: Maybe worker reassign increments stream_id but we don't reseed accordingly. Should be deterministic if we hand off RNG state.
michael: I remember a fix for deterministic handoff but only for non-quantized kernels. Quant kernels serialize RNG differently.
kai: For a quick workaround, set RUNNER_RNG_MODE=per-request to force seed per request; that'll be slower but deterministic. But we should fix handoff.
alice: Tried RUNNER_RNG_MODE=per-request — reproduces deterministically now. Good to know.
sasha: Can you open a flaky CI job with `eval-harness/failures/*` and attach logs? CI currently doesn't capture stream_id.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Created issue #4521 and uploaded archived logs: https://redwood.internal/ci/4521 :white_check_mark:
michael: Action items: (1) add stream_id + seed to all sampler telemetry (2) ensure RNG state serialization for q4 kernels (3) add CI check that resumes produce identical checksums.
kai: I'll own (2) — will instrument q-kernel RNG serialize/deserialize and add unit tests.
sasha: I'll update CI job to run resume smoke with quantized model and checksum compare.
alice: Thanks. For the bug writeup: suspected cause = worker-level stream counter incremented on restart but not restoring RNG stream offset. I'll add reproduction steps to #4521.
michael: :thumbsup: if anyone sees this in prod, set RUNNER_RNG_MODE=per-request as emergency rollback.
